products.pds_title: Corporate Travel Insurance – Combined Financial Services Guide and Product Disclosure Statement
products.geographic_scope: Worldwide cover for business journeys (international, interstate and intrastate) more than 100 km from home or business; subject to sanctions and Smartraveller ‘Do not travel’ exclusions noted in the PDS.
products.eligibility_rules: Corporate annual policy purchased by a company for eligible employees and nominated persons. All insured persons must be Australian residents with a valid Medicare card or be living in Australia with a visa to live/work/study, and return home within 6 months of commencing each journey. Journeys must be >100 km from home or business. Up to 4 weeks’ leisure travel may be included with a business trip for employees (6 weeks for Directors/CEO/CFO/COO; plus up to 6 weeks’ independent leisure for those executives).
products.age_eligibility_notes: No maximum age. Special conditions for age 75+: $5,000 excess applies to Sections 1 & 4; no benefit under Section 15 Disability; $25,000 max under Section 16 Accidental death; no benefit under Section 14 Loss of income (injury) and Section 21 Loss of income (sickness); Sections 6 and 7 limited to $5,000. For under 18: Section 15 max $50,000 for injury types 2–19; Section 16 max $25,000.
products.policy_cancellation_refund_terms: 21-day cooling off for full refund if no travel has commenced and no claim intended; after 21 days, pro‑rata adjustments based on actual travel days if cancelled within 180 days (refund capped at 50% and not below minimum policy value). No refund after 180 days or if a claim paid. Insurer may cancel per law with adjustment based on actual travel days.
products.excess_options: Standard excess: $60 per event on Sections 1, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and Section 39 where relevant. Age 75+ excess: $5,000 per claim for Sections 1 and 4. Additional excesses may apply for approved existing medical condition cover and will be advised in writing.

excess_rules.amount: $60 per event per journey (Sections 1,4,6,7,8,9,10, and Section 39 where relevant)
No excess shown in table for assistance/evacuation

products.emergency_medical_limit: $10,000,000 (cover will not exceed 18 months from onset)
products.travel_delay_limit: $1,000 (includes up to $200 after 6 hours and $200 each further 24 hours)
products.luggage_single_item_limit: $1,000 per any other item (higher category limits apply; see sub-limits)
products.electronics_or_valuables_limit: Cameras/video/laptop/tablet up to $4,000 each; phone/smartwatch/jewellery/watch $1,000 each (per-item)
products.travel_documents_limit: Included under Section 8 Luggage; plus up to $3,000 legal liability for illegal use of documents/cards
products.personal_accident_limit: $Nil (Sections 14–16 not payable on Essentials; see benefit table)
products.covid_medical_limit: Included under Section 1 limit; maximum 12 months from onset when diagnosed with COVID‑19 overseas
products.covid_cover_summary: COVID‑19 medical overseas covered when diagnosed; additional expenses covered if hospitalised; limited cancellation/amendment scenarios only (e.g., diagnosis before departure; essential health worker leave revoked; life‑threatening diagnosis of a non‑travelling relative in AU/NZ). No cover for government border closures/quarantine or ‘Do not travel’ destinations where the advisory relates to COVID‑19.

sub_limits.name: Per-item limits
sub_limits.amount: Phone $1,000; Smart watch $1,000; Camera $4,000; Video camera $4,000; Drone $1,000; Laptop $4,000; Tablet $4,000; Artificial limb $1,000; Dentures $1,000; Removable dental appliance $1,000; Medical device $1,000; Jewellery $1,000; Watch $1,000; Any other item $1,000

products.limit_basis_notes: Unless stated otherwise, limits apply per insured person, per journey. Annual sums reinstated after each journey.
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: A list of specified conditions is automatically covered if stability/criteria met (e.g., Asthma under 60, stable; Diabetes without complications; Hypertension without CVD, etc.). Other existing medical conditions, chronic lung disease, cardiovascular disease or reduced immunity require health assessment at or before the relevant time and payment of any additional premium; otherwise no cover for claims arising from or exacerbated by those conditions. Some conditions (e.g., drug/alcohol dependency; routine/cosmetic treatment; undiagnosed/awaiting opinion) are not coverable.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Serious, unexpected pregnancy complications covered up to 23 weeks 6 days gestation; childbirth and newborn care excluded. Must complete health assessment if complications (current or prior), multiple pregnancy or assisted conception (e.g., IVF).
products.non_traveller_health_rules: Cover for cancellation/curtailment due to a non-travelling relative/business partner only if at relevant time they met strict criteria (not hospitalised in past 12 months for related condition; not in aged care; living independently; not awaiting tests/surgery; no drug/alcohol addiction; no terminal illness). If criteria not met, maximum $1,000 under all sections combined.

included_activities.conditions: Not racing or in a professional capacity; general terms apply
Must hold Open Water certificate or dive with qualified instructor

excluded_activities.exclusion: Hunting; racing (other than on foot); polo; hang gliding; off-piste snow sports; rodeo; BASE jumping; motocross; freestyle BMX; running with the bulls; professional sports; mountaineering/rock climbing using guides/ropes/oxygen; scuba diving without appropriate certification/instructor
Motorcycling/moped riding over 250cc, or without proper licence/helmet, not hired, racing/professional/motocross

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Cover applies when hiring a rental car, named on the rental agreement, and comprehensive motor vehicle insurance is purchased. We pay the lesser of the excess or repair costs. No cover for breach of rental terms, unsealed-surface damage, administration or loss-of-use fees.
products.luggage_conditions: No cover for valuables checked in with a carrier unless forced by security regulations; report loss/theft to police and relevant provider within 7 days; daylight motor vehicle/towed vehicle cover only in concealed locked compartment with forced entry, capped at $1,000 per item/$2,000 total; no cover for items left unattended in a public place or any vehicle overnight; IMEI blocking required for mobile phone claims; depreciation applies per table.

depreciation_rules.category: Communication devices; all computers; electrical/electronic items; photographic equipment; smartwatches; tablets

products.business_cover_details: Corporate-specific benefits include Kidnap & Ransom (Essentials: $100k), Hijacking (Nil), Extra Territorial Workers Compensation (Nil), Identity theft protection (Nil), and standard business property within Luggage. Higher-tier plans add Alternative staff/resumption of assignment, workers compensation, and extensive extras (see higher tiers).
products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: Travel to countries/areas under Smartraveller ‘Do not travel’ may void cover when the warning relates to the claim cause (including COVID‑19). Sanctions clause excludes cover/benefits where doing so would expose the insurer to sanctions. Exclusions for specified regions (e.g., Cuba, Iran, Syria, North Korea, Crimea/DNR/LNR).
products.claims_process_summary: Request claim form via corporate@covermore.com.au; submit by email or post with required evidence. You will hear back within 10 working days after receipt; claims may be approved, investigated, declined or require more info. Notify any claim or occurrence within 60 days of return. Claims paid in AUD by bank transfer.
products.emergency_assistance_details: Contact 24/7 emergency assistance for hospitalisation, expenses expected to exceed $2,000, or early return. Australia +61 2 8907 5619; Toll-free: USA 1800 937 9763, Canada 1800 645 8714, UK 0800 892 014, NZ 0800 445 524.
products.premium_factors: Estimated number of journeys (domestic/overseas), average days per trip, destination/area, trip duration, add-on variations (e.g., existing medical conditions, extras).

products.geographic_scope: Worldwide cover for business journeys (international, interstate and intrastate) more than 100 km from home or business; subject to sanctions and Smartraveller ‘Do not travel’ exclusions noted in the PDS.
products.eligibility_rules: Corporate annual policy purchased by a company for eligible employees and nominated persons. All insured persons must be Australian residents with a valid Medicare card or be living in Australia with a visa to live/work/study, and return home within 6 months of commencing each journey. Journeys must be >100 km from home or business. Up to 4 weeks’ leisure travel may be included with a business trip for employees (6 weeks for Directors/CEO/CFO/COO; plus up to 6 weeks’ independent leisure for those executives).
products.age_eligibility_notes: No maximum age. Special conditions for age 75+: $5,000 excess applies to Sections 1 & 4; no benefit under Section 15 Disability; $25,000 max under Section 16 Accidental death; no benefit under Section 14 Loss of income (injury) and Section 21 Loss of income (sickness); Sections 6 and 7 limited to $5,000. For under 18: Section 15 max $50,000 for injury types 2–19; Section 16 max $25,000.
products.policy_cancellation_refund_terms: 21-day cooling off for full refund if no travel has commenced and no claim intended; after 21 days, pro‑rata adjustments based on actual travel days if cancelled within 180 days (refund capped at 50% and not below minimum policy value). No refund after 180 days or if a claim paid. Insurer may cancel per law with adjustment based on actual travel days.
products.excess_options: Standard excess: $60 per event on Sections 1, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and Section 39 where relevant (policy wording). Benefits table indicates several sections with ‘No’ excess for this tier (e.g., assistance, evacuation, Sections 2, 3, 6, 11–19) – see table evidence.

excess_rules.amount: $60 per event per journey (Sections 1,4,6,7,8,9,10, and Section 39 where relevant)

excess_rules.section: Sections with no excess per benefits table
excess_rules.amount: No excess for 24 hour assistance, medical evacuation; Sections 2, 3, 6, 11–19 show ‘No’

products.emergency_medical_limit: Unlimited (cover will not exceed 18 months from onset)
products.travel_delay_limit: Unlimited (includes up to $200 after 6 hours and $200 each further 24 hours)
products.luggage_single_item_limit: $1,000 per any other item (higher category limits apply; see sub-limits)
products.electronics_or_valuables_limit: Cameras/video/laptop/tablet up to $4,000 each; phone/smartwatch/jewellery/watch $1,000 each (per-item)
products.travel_documents_limit: Included under Section 8 Luggage; plus up to $3,000 legal liability for illegal use of documents/cards
products.covid_medical_limit: Included under Section 1 limit; maximum 12 months from onset when diagnosed with COVID‑19 overseas
products.covid_cover_summary: COVID‑19 medical overseas covered when diagnosed; additional expenses covered if hospitalised; limited cancellation/amendment scenarios (e.g., diagnosis pre‑departure; essential health worker leave revoked; life‑threatening diagnosis of a non‑travelling relative in AU/NZ). No cover for government border closures/quarantine or ‘Do not travel’ destinations where the advisory relates to COVID‑19.

optional_add_ons.name: Optional Extra Benefits Package (Sections 29–38)
optional_add_ons.availability: Available on Corporate Ultimate/Ultimate Plus for additional premium
optional_add_ons.changes_or_limits: Court attendance benefit $100/day to $1,000; Independent financial advice $5,000; Spouse/partner accidental death $25,000; Dependent child assistance – Education fund $5,000 per child (max $15,000/family), Orphaned benefit $10,000 per child (max $30,000/family); Partner retraining $10,000; Corporate image protection $15,000; Home/motor vehicle modification $10,000; Unexpired membership $500; Keys and locks $1,000; Home burglary $1,000

sub_limits.name: Per-item limits
sub_limits.amount: Phone $1,000; Smart watch $1,000; Camera $4,000; Video camera $4,000; Drone $1,000; Laptop $4,000; Tablet $4,000; Artificial limb $1,000; Dentures $1,000; Removable dental appliance $1,000; Medical device $1,000; Jewellery $1,000; Watch $1,000; Any other item $1,000

products.limit_basis_notes: Unless stated otherwise, limits apply per insured person, per journey. Annual sums reinstated after each journey.
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: A list of specified conditions is automatically covered if stability/criteria met (e.g., Asthma under 60, stable; Diabetes without complications; Hypertension without CVD, etc.). Other existing medical conditions, chronic lung disease, cardiovascular disease or reduced immunity require health assessment at or before the relevant time and payment of any additional premium; otherwise no cover for claims arising from or exacerbated by those conditions. Some conditions (e.g., drug/alcohol dependency; routine/cosmetic treatment; undiagnosed/awaiting opinion) are not coverable.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Serious, unexpected pregnancy complications covered up to 23 weeks 6 days gestation; childbirth and newborn care excluded. Must complete health assessment if complications (current or prior), multiple pregnancy or assisted conception (e.g., IVF).
products.non_traveller_health_rules: Cover for cancellation/curtailment due to a non-travelling relative/business partner only if at relevant time they met strict criteria (not hospitalised in past 12 months for related condition; not in aged care; living independently; not awaiting tests/surgery; no drug/alcohol addiction; no terminal illness). If criteria not met, maximum $1,000 under all sections combined.

included_activities.conditions: Not racing or in a professional capacity; general terms apply
Must hold Open Water certificate or dive with qualified instructor

excluded_activities.exclusion: Hunting; racing (other than on foot); polo; hang gliding; off-piste snow sports; rodeo; BASE jumping; motocross; freestyle BMX; running with the bulls; professional sports; mountaineering/rock climbing using guides/ropes/oxygen; scuba diving without appropriate certification/instructor
Motorcycling/moped riding over 250cc, or without proper licence/helmet, not hired, racing/professional/motocross

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Cover applies when hiring a rental car, named on the rental agreement, and comprehensive motor vehicle insurance is purchased. We pay the lesser of the excess or repair costs. No cover for breach of rental terms, unsealed-surface damage, administration or loss-of-use fees.
products.luggage_conditions: No cover for valuables checked in with a carrier unless forced by security regulations; report loss/theft to police and relevant provider within 7 days; daylight motor vehicle/towed vehicle cover only in concealed locked compartment with forced entry, capped at $1,000 per item/$2,000 total; no cover for items left unattended in a public place or any vehicle overnight; IMEI blocking required for mobile phone claims; depreciation applies per table.

depreciation_rules.category: Communication devices; all computers; electrical/electronic items; photographic equipment; smartwatches; tablets

products.business_cover_details: Includes ‘Included Extras’ for Ultimate tiers: Media/image protection $10,000; Trauma counselling $5,000; Personal legal costs (detainment) $30,000; Loss of income (sickness) $144,000; Tuition expenses $3,000; Injury surgery up to $20,000; Fractured bones up to $5,000; Dental injury up to $5,000; Political unrest & disaster evacuation $50,000; Personal car excess/repairs $2,000; Loss of no-claim bonus/hire car $2,500.
products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: Travel to countries/areas under Smartraveller ‘Do not travel’ may void cover when the warning relates to the claim cause (including COVID‑19). Sanctions clause excludes cover/benefits where doing so would expose the insurer to sanctions. Exclusions for specified regions (e.g., Cuba, Iran, Syria, North Korea, Crimea/DNR/LNR).
products.claims_process_summary: Request claim form via corporate@covermore.com.au; submit by email or post with required evidence. You will hear back within 10 working days after receipt; claims may be approved, investigated, declined or require more info. Notify any claim or occurrence within 60 days of return. Claims paid in AUD by bank transfer.
products.emergency_assistance_details: Contact 24/7 emergency assistance for hospitalisation, expenses expected to exceed $2,000, or early return. Australia +61 2 8907 5619; Toll-free: USA 1800 937 9763, Canada 1800 645 8714, UK 0800 892 014, NZ 0800 445 524.

data._document_notes: Section 39 (COVID-19 benefits) includes two maximum-benefit tables for Amendment or cancellation costs on p40 which appear inconsistent. One table shows ‘No cover’ for Essentials/Essentials Plus/Ultimate and specific limits only for Ultimate Plus; the second table shows Overseas trips $10,000 and Domestic trips $5,000 for Essentials, Essentials Plus and Ultimate (with an empty Ultimate Plus cell). Due to this ambiguity, covid_cancellation_or_disruption_limit has been left null and the COVID cover has been summarised textually. All other limits reflect the primary benefits tables on pp5–7 and policy wording sections.
